findings.title: Removal listener can throw UnsupportedOperationException under V2
findings.body: registerListener now guards on ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ but management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 when ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled, whose ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled/isPermissionsEnabled unconditionally throw UnsupportedOperationException. If both features are enabled, deleting a client/group/role triggers that throwing path and breaks removal. The listener must branch on V2 / no-op for V2 or avoid calling per-object permission APIs.

findings.title: Wrong owner used for resource lookup, per-client permissions never found
findings.body: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) and hasPermission(String) look up with resourceStore.findByName(server, name, server.getId()). AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource creates resources with owner resourceServer.getClientId(), and getResourceTypeResource looks up without owner. Using server.getId() as owner will miss existing per-client resources, so evaluation always falls back to the all-clients resource or denies, breaking single-client grants.

findings.title: Missing null-check and missing all-clients fallback causes NPE / deny
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel,String) when the per-client resource is absent the code loads the Clients type resource and immediately calls findByResource(server, resource) and new ResourcePermission(resource,...) without checking for null. If the type resource is missing this NPEs. Worse, when the per-client resource exists but evaluates to deny, the all-clients grant is never consulted, so a valid all-clients MANAGE/VIEW/CONFIGURE permission is ignored.

findings.title: getClientsWithPermission returns type resource name and ignores all-clients grant
findings.body: getClientsWithPermission iterates findByType(CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE) and adds resource.getName() for each granted resource. That includes the all-clients resource whose name is literally Clients, leaking a non-client id to callers, and it never expands an all-clients grant to all clients. Listing/filtering with VIEW/MANAGE will therefore be wrong when only the all-clients permission exists.

findings.title: getResourceName does not handle Clients type
findings.body: getResourceName only special-cases USERS_RESOURCE_TYPE (All users / username lookup) and falls through to resource.getDisplayName() for everything else. Client resources store the client UUID as name with no display name, so admin UI/API for Clients permissions will show null/UUID instead of All clients or clientId, unlike the Users path.

findings.title: getScope can NPE on unknown resourceType
findings.body: getScope does SCHEMA.getResourceTypes().get(resourceType).getScopes() without checking that resourceType exists. An unknown or null resourceType causes NullPointerException instead of the intended ModelValidationException about scope not found for resource type, turning a 400 into a 500.
